overallAssessment.summary: Strong evidence of forgery detected. The document appears to be a Bulgarian passport with a digitally inserted photo of Sylvester Stallone. Metadata indicates the image was processed with 'paint.net', further supporting digital manipulation. The document is also expired relative to the reference date.

overall_verdict.reason: The primary portrait is clearly a digitally inserted image of a well-known celebrity (Sylvester Stallone) onto a Bulgarian passport template. The file metadata indicates image editing software ('paint.net') was used. The date of birth on the document (1957) does not match the actual birth year of Sylvester Stallone (1946), creating an age inconsistency.

evidence_points: The primary portrait is a digitally inserted image of Sylvester Stallone, a known public figure, which is inconsistent with a genuine personal identification document.
File metadata indicates the image was processed using 'paint.net 4.2.15', a common image editing software, suggesting digital manipulation.
Significant lighting and texture inconsistencies are observed between the inserted portrait and the rest of the document background.
The date of birth (27.07.1957) on the document is inconsistent with the actual birth year of Sylvester Stallone (1946), indicating a data mismatch for the depicted individual.
The document's expiry date (30.03.2021) is in the past relative to the reference date (2025-07-29), rendering the document invalid.
supporting_evidence.recommendation: Reject the document. Further investigation into the source of this forged document is recommended.
